ns2:course.label: Exploring Geology in the Field
ns2:course.description: Introduces practical techniques for identification of rocks, minerals, and fossils; interpretation of geologic maps and cross-sections; appreciation of Midwestern geologic history and geologic features and landforms in the field. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Two field trips (a 1-day and a 3-day trip) and a field trip fee are required.
